title: Sasirangan Metaverse 3D
content_en:
Project Overview

Sasirangan Metaverse 3D is an award-winning cultural tech web experience built for the SDGs Creative Web Competition (SDG 11 Culture Verse). It transforms traditional South Kalimantan Sasirangan cloth into an interactive 3D virtual museum with real-time WebGL rendering and gamified scrollytelling.

The Challenge

Traditional textile heritages often struggle to engage younger digital generations through static museum exhibits or 2D image galleries, risking the loss of historical motif appreciation.

The Solution

Using Three.js, React Three Fiber, and custom GLSL shaders, this project delivers realistic fabric texture physics, 360-degree interactive camera navigation, and dynamic lighting that highlights the intricate hand-dyed stitch patterns of Sasirangan textiles.

Key Features

  • 3D WebGL Cloth Simulation: Interactive 3D models of Sasirangan fabric with realistic draping and surface textures.
  • Motif Explorer: Detailed historical breakdowns of sacred motifs (Gigi Haruan, Kangkung Kaombakan, Naga Balimbur).
  • Gamified Scrollytelling: Seamless GSAP scroll-triggered animations guiding users through the traditional crafting process.
  • SDG 11 Culture Verse: Dedicated to preserving sustainable cultural heritage through cutting-edge web technologies.

Ringkasan Proyek

Sasirangan Metaverse 3D adalah pengalaman web teknologi budaya yang dikembangkan untuk SDGs Creative Web Competition (SDG 11 Culture Verse). Menransformasikan kain tradisional Sasirangan khas Kalimantan Selatan ke dalam museum virtual 3D interaktif dengan rendering WebGL real-time dan gamified scrollytelling.

Tantangan

Warisan tekstil tradisional sering kali kesulitan menarik minat generasi digital muda melalui pameran statis atau galeri foto 2D biasa, sehingga makna filosofis motif bersejarah berisiko terlupakan.

Solusi Teknis

Menggunakan Three.js, React Three Fiber, dan GLSL shader khusus, proyek ini menghadirkan simulasi fisika tekstur kain yang realistis, kontrol kamera 360 derajat, dan pencahayaan dinamis yang menonjolkan detail jahitan jelujur tradisional kain Sasirangan.

Fitur Utama

  • Simulasi Kain 3D WebGL: Model 3D interaktif kain Sasirangan dengan lipatan dan tekstur permukaan realistis.
  • Eksplorasi Motif: Penjelasan mendalam makna filosofis motif sakral (Gigi Haruan, Kangkung Kaombakan, Naga Balimbur).
  • Gamified Scrollytelling: Animasi GSAP responsif berbasis scroll yang memandu pengguna mempelajari proses pembuatan kain.
  • SDG 11 Culture Verse: Didedikasikan untuk melestarikan warisan budaya berkelanjutan melalui teknologi web mutakhir.
